reason: Each test starts a browser with Playwright's launchServer, a child Node process whose browser a signal ends, and reads its exit code and signal. Strider has no launchServer and no remote server process; its launched browser belongs to the scope that launched it, and the browser's Info has no process id to signal. SI-004, SI-006, and SI-007 to SI-009 also need the handleSIGINT and handleSIGHUP options (matrix rows option-browsertype-launchserver-handlesigint and option-browsertype-launchserver-handlesighup), which Strider doesn't take
